diagnosis.what_happened: In regression ANOVA / model summary tables presenting multiple criteria or models, rows are sometimes redundantly labeled with parentheticals (e.g. 'رگرسیون (رفتارهای خودآسیبی)', 'باقیمانده (رفتارهای خودآسیبی)', 'کل (رفتارهای خودآسیبی)').
diagnosis.behavior_caused_outcome: Repetitive parenthetical labeling clutters regression tables, increases visual noise, and violates clean APA 7 institutional Persian table formatting.
diagnosis.what_should_have_happened: In multi-model regression ANOVA tables, the regression row must simply be labeled with the dependent variable name (e.g., 'رفتارهای خودآسیبی'), while the residual and total rows must be labeled simply as 'باقیمانده' and 'کل' without repeating the variable name in parentheses. For subsequent regressions in the same table, repeat this concise pattern (e.g., 'رفتارهای خودکشی', 'باقیمانده', 'کل').
diagnosis.rationale_why: Concise row headers improve readability and align with Persian institutional dissertation standards where hierarchical row structure makes parenthetical repetition redundant.

desired_behavior: In all regression ANOVA tables (خلاصه مدل و تحلیل واریانس), format source of variance rows as: [Variable Name], 'باقیمانده', 'کل' for each criterion variable, strictly omitting parenthetical variable names on residual and total rows.
generalization: Never repeat variable names in parentheses for residual and total rows across any regression or ANOVA table in AcademicSuite.

evidence.observed_value: رگرسیون (رفتارهای خودآسیبی) / باقیمانده (رفتارهای خودآسیبی) / کل (رفتارهای خودآسیبی)
